title: Synapse Band v1 GATT contract (v1, frozen)
description: Canonical GATT contract shared by config/hardware.yaml, firmware/esp32_band/ble (research + feature stream services), sdk/python/synapse_device/transport.py and Averyn's SynapseBleAdapter. UUIDs are immutable once a consumer imports them.

research.description: Raw sample research stream (ECG/PPG/ACC/GYRO/MAG/POWER) + clock sync

feature_stream.description: Consumer feature stream (HR/RR/SQI/stress) + device config + provisioning
